[EN] People say they wish it was like the good old days, but I wonder whether they were really all that "good."
[ES] La gente dice que desearía que fuera como los viejos tiempos, pero me pregunto si de verdad fueron tan "buenos".

[EN] I'll look into matters immediately.
[ES] Investigaré los asuntos de inmediato.

[EN] The spirit cores are indeed tainted.
[ES] Los núcleos espirituales están efectivamente contaminados.
